headline: Dax set to retreat as ceasefire concerns weigh on sentiment
summary: Following recent market fireworks, sobriety is expected to take hold of the German equity market on Thursday. Banks and brokerages expect the Dax to open lower amid ceasefire concerns.
why: The DAX is the benchmark index of Germany's 40 largest listed companies, and it reflects European export and industrial exposure. Its moves shape sentiment across European equities.

impacts.name: DAX
impacts.why: Ceasefire concerns are expected to weigh on German equities at the open.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Ceasefire concerns are weighing on sentiment after recent market swings, and the index is expected to retreat. Doubts about a Middle East truce raise geopolitical risk and pressure equities.
